description: Defines the SineGenerator class for generating sine wave audio signals, including setup, sweep, rendering, and amplitude control methods.

classes.name: SineGenerator
classes.description: A class for generating sine wave audio signals with support for frequency sweeping and multi-format rendering.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes the generator with a specific frequency and frame rate.

methods.name: setSweep
methods.description: Configures a frequency sweep from low to high over a specified duration.

methods.name: next
methods.description: Calculates the next sine sample value based on current phase.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders sine wave samples into buffers of various data types (int16_t, float, int32_t, 24-bit).

methods.name: setAmplitude
methods.description: Sets the amplitude of the sine wave.

methods.name: advancePhase
methods.description: Advances the phase of the sine wave, handling sweeping logic.
